useCase: Detection of local 操作 (cut-paste, editing), AI inpainting, and regions with inconsistent compression history. Widely used in digital 画像フォレンジック and content verification.
mechanism:
The ELA 分析 process:

1. **Re-compression**: The image is re-saved at a fixed JPEG品質 level (typically 95%).

2. **Difference calculation**: Pixel-by-pixel comparison 間の the original and re-compressed image, creating an absolute difference map.

3. **Error パターン 分析**: In an unmodified JPEG, the entire image has undergone the same compression, so error levels are relatively uniform. Manipulated or AI生成の regions show different error levels because they've undergone different compression histories.

4. **Uniformity assessment**: AI images typically show abnormally uniform error levels にわたる the entire image because all pixels were generated, not captured.
accuracy: 高 - 88-94% for JPEG images. Effectiveness significantly decreases for PNG images or multiply-compressed JPEGs.
name: エラーレベル分析 (ELA)
parameters:
Re-compression quality: 95%, Color space: YCbCr, DCT block size: 8x8
Analysis: absolute pixel difference, regional error level 分散
閾値: 適応型 based on global error 分布
description: エラーレベル分析 resaves an image at a known JPEG品質 and compares the error levels 間の the original and re-compressed version. AI生成の images show abnormally uniform error パターン, while authentic photos exhibit varying 圧縮アーティファクト異なる領域にわたって.

references.title: Krawetz, N. (2007). A Picture's Worth: Digital Image Analysis and Forensics. Hacker Factor.
Krawetz, N. (2012). A Picture's Worth — More on ELA. Black Hat USA.
Farid, H. (2009). Image Forgery Detection. IEEE Signal Processing Magazine.
Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005). Exposing Digital Forgeries by Detecting Traces of Resampling. IEEE TSP.

strengths:
• Intuitive and easy to understand for non-experts
• Good 検出 of local 操作 and スプライシング
• Low computational cost, fast 分析
• Particularly effective with single-compression JPEGs
limitations:
• Only effective for JPEG images, not applicable to PNG/WebP
• Multiple JPEG圧縮s introduce noise into results
• Resized or cropped images may produce 誤検出
• Cannot distinguish AI from heavily post-processed real images
